summary.nextFocus: Add measurable results to interview answers.

mistakeBank.original: I worked on many things and it was good for the company.
mistakeBank.correction: I worked on customer feedback analysis, which helped the team prioritize product fixes.
mistakeBank.note: Replace vague phrases with a specific action and result.

mistakeBank.original: Maybe I need something from finance soon.
mistakeBank.correction: I need the final pricing file from finance by Thursday to finish the proposal.
mistakeBank.note: Make requests specific: owner, item and deadline.

mistakeBank.original: Our product is not expensive because it is good.
mistakeBank.correction: The price is connected to the time your team can save each month.
mistakeBank.note: Connect pricing to the customer's business value.

mistakeBank.correction: Yes, it has been a good week. How about yours?
mistakeBank.note: Add a short follow-up question to keep the conversation natural.
